```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/12.234.56.126/communicating_files?limit=10&cursor=pointer" \
     -H "x-apikey: my_api"
```

| Parameter | Value | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `limit=10` | Max 10 results per page | Controls pagination size |
| `cursor=pointer` | Continuation token | Lets you fetch the next page of results |
| `x-apikey: my_api` | Your API key | Authenticates the request |

**Next steps**

1. Run the above `curl` command (or use your preferred HTTP client).  
2. Inspect the JSON response – it will contain the file IDs, names, and other metadata.  
3. If you need more than 10 results, use the `next_cursor` value returned in the response to fetch subsequent pages.
